existing_features.title: Ensure customers have a clearly visible "Report an Issue" action for each of their bookings, and that submitting an issue creates an admin notification categorized as "issues" with a distinct (issue-specific) color treatment in the admin Notifications panel.
Update the admin Booking Management view to clearly include previous (past) bookings and visually distinguish expired bookings using a different color treatment from active bookings.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add a customer-facing “Report an issue” button and show submitted issues in the admin notifications with a distinct color
Allow admin to view previous/expired bookings and display expired bookings in a distinct color

projectName: Customer issue reporting notifications + admin past/expired bookings highlighting
